description: Changes one staff member (staff_id, from read staff_roster or staff_detail) as Save in their staff drawer does. Pass only what changes: employmentType (employee reads Staff, contractor reads Contractor), payRateCents with payRateUnit (hour, visit or percent; null clears), publicBookable (customers can pick them on the booking page), portalBookable (clients can pick them in the portal), payHidden (hide their pay from payroll views), venmo / zelle (tip handles; empty clears). To rename, use add_staff_member with rename_staff_id. Ending someone's employment is done by a person on the staff page. Nothing is sent. For several people, call once per person. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

portalBookable.title: Clients can pick them in the portal

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.
